author: Numberz_
body:
When appealing for a temp-ban/ban on the Avicus Network please include the following: 
  • Your Minecraft username(most recent name if changed): McZone
  • The reason you were temp-banned/banned: Combat logging.
  • Why you should be unbanned from the server: The reason I feel I should be unbanned is simple, this upcoming Saturday is the quarter finals for Berzerk and I really need to be able to play for them. This is also my first punishment for void/combat logging and three days seems a bit tough for a first time infraction. I have always followed the server rules to the best of my abilities, I made a mistake I'm very sorry and hope  that you accept this appeal so I can get back on Avicus.
  • Was my temp-ban or ban really false? Not that I know of. The infraction has "R" meaning its recorded?
  • Do I have any evidence to show the staff if was false?: No, I wasn't recording at the time.
  • Have I waited long enough to be un-banned?: I don't know what the set time is, I woke up and found out I was tempbanned.
  • Have I been caught ban evading?: Nope.
  • Have I appealed a ban before?: I have appealed my sister's two warns.
When it comes to appealing an infraction. The only thing that helps it is the amount of time you serve that infraction.

Do not expect to be appealed a day after you ban if you know that it wasn't a false ban. You must face the consequences.

Just a side note if I could please discuss this with a senior mod on Skype/Teamspeak that would be great, I'm sorry for my actions they will not happen again. Thank you.

title: McZone Appeal

replies.author: Iron
replies.body:
Hello,

Your infraction will not be appealed. I have decided not to appeal you because first of all, it was your decision to break the rules. Also, as you would know the minimum ban for a combat logging infraction is 3 days. In this case the moderator did punish you correctly, wish your team good luck! You will be able to participate in the final.

Thanks,
Iron,
Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
